stable_freestanding.purpose: An annotated no_std/no_main object with its own panic handler and an exported C-ABI function. No host, linker script, executable, or runtime behavior is claimed. Negative fixtures remain separate crates and may use std.

stable_procedural_macros.purpose: Define function-like, derive, and attribute macros in a companion crate, then invoke and audit them in a consumer. Preserve expansion provenance.

historical_editions.purpose: Run separate compiler configurations for edition-dependent grammar. This does not emulate historical compiler releases.

nightly.purpose: Select an exact nightly revision and extract a separate inventory. Use compatible gate sets from dependency and incompatibility tables; never enable all gates indiscriminately.

target_specific.purpose: Declare concrete target triples and prerequisites before enabling ABI, linker, assembly, or architecture-specific examples. Record compile-only and executable cases separately.
